packageRules.description: sha2 and digest are capped below 0.11 — opaque-ke 4.x requires the digest 0.10 trait family. Patch updates within 0.10.x still flow through. When upgrading opaque-ke to a digest-0.11-compatible version, update this allowedVersions in the same PR.
hkdf is capped below 0.13 — opaque-ke 4.x requires hkdf 0.12 (digest 0.10 trait family). Patch updates within 0.12.x still flow through. Update in the same PR as the opaque-ke upgrade.

rand_core is capped below 0.7 — 0.10 removed the `getrandom` feature flag that OsRng depends on, breaking the build. Updating requires verifying opaque-ke 4.x compatibility with rand_core 0.10 and adjusting OsRng usage in opaque_pake_adapter, hsm_wrapper, and worker_service. Update in the same PR as the opaque-ke upgrade.

p256 and elliptic-curve are capped below 0.14 — elliptic-curve 0.14 split the hash2curve/oprf modules out into standalone crates with a new OprfParameters trait, but opaque-ke 4.x (including the 4.1.0-pre.2 prerelease) still depends on the voprf crate 0.5.0, which requires the old elliptic_curve::voprf::VoprfParameters trait from 0.13. NistP256 in p256 0.14 no longer implements that trait, so opaque_ke::CipherSuite fails to resolve. Update in the same PR as the opaque-ke upgrade, once a release compatible with elliptic-curve 0.14 exists.
